walkie.title: Walkie-talkie
walkie.toggleHint: Talk live to everyone who has this chat open. Nothing is recorded.
walkie.talkHint: Hold to talk and release to stop, or tap once to keep talking and tap again to stop.
walkie.youAreLive: You're live. Release or tap to stop.
walkie.listening_one: {{count}} other person is listening. Hold the button to talk.
walkie.listening_other: {{count}} others are listening. Hold the button to talk.
walkie.nobodyListening: On. Others hear you when they have this chat open with walkie-talkie on.
walkie.listenHint: Turns on walkie-talkie to hear them live

errors.forbidden: Walkie-talkie isn't available in this chat.
errors.unavailable: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_installed: Walkie-talkie needs the latest version of the app.
errors.same_uid: Walkie-talkie was opened on another device.
